title: Releases
about: Build the product, deploy it to the first environment, then let the release climb the environments in order: each environment takes from the one before it. A build is published in Studio, the IDE or CI; a deploy names it and the server installs it with the environment's connection. A protected environment waits for an administrator to approve.
no_project: Open a project to see how its product goes out.
no_environments_backend: This Studio has no environments yet (the backend predates them).
no_environment: No environment yet. Ask an organization administrator for one under Organization › Infrastructure.

uninstall_body: Its pods stop; its database stays.
no_published_chart: No build has published a chart yet: build it under Build, or publish from the IDE's Deploy.

bind_first: Bind a profile to {environment} to give its release chart values.
values_saved: Values for {profile} in {environment} saved: the next deploy uses them.
secrets_where: kept in credstore, given to every application as environment variables
secret_set: {key} set for {environment}: the next deploy writes it.
research_secrets_why: Research's public API has no secret variables and returns a service's variables as they are, so a secret set here reaches the application as a plain environment variable (ADR-0049 §4).
research_previews_why: A preview is a namespace of its own beside the environment (ADR-0055); a Research environment has no namespace, so it takes deploys only.

ci_none_body: They arrive with the next sync of the project's sources, if the connection can read the repository's Actions.

build_workflow_unset_why: Which workflow builds the product is not set yet: pick it and use it as the build workflow.
build_workflow_set: {workflow} in {repo} is the project's build workflow now.
ci_no_file: Its runs name no workflow file this connection can start
ci_started: Started {workflow} on {ref} in {repo}. The run shows here after the next sync of the project's sources.
revision_title: The revision of the product description it was built with
lost_body: Lost: no word from its Job since {since}, past the hour a build may take. How it ended is not known; build again.
bindings_none: The organization has no environment this project may deploy to yet.
bindings_hint: Pick the kubernetes profile of the product each environment runs; one profile may run in several. Deploy takes the namespace and the image registry from the environment.
path_specs_none: The specifications name no capability yet: write them under Specs. The product can be composed without them.
path_specs_unknown: What the specifications need could not be read here.
cause_GEAR_BUILD_FAILED: Gear {gear} did not build; the build around it is fine.
cause_SECRET_MISSING: The product reads a secret nothing sets: {key}.
cause_QUOTA_OR_HARDWARE_LIMIT: A quota or a hardware limit is reached.
cause_RESEARCH_SIGN_IN_EXPIRED: Your Constructor Research sign-in has run out or was withdrawn.
cause_IMAGE_PULL_FAILED: The cluster could not pull the product's image.
cause_CLUSTER_UNREACHABLE: It never reached the cluster: the environment's cluster did not answer, or its connection may not do what the run needs.
cause_CONNECTION_UNREADABLE: A connection the run needs could not be read as the organization's service: most often a personal one.
cause_APP_CRASHED: The application started and then stopped or did not answer: its log says why.
cause_UNKNOWN: It failed; its log says why.
